name: EDLR 5117
title: College Student Development: Theory and Practice
description: This course examines a range of theories related to student learning, growth, and development during the college years. While the course explores the historical, philosophical, and theoretical foundations of student development theory related to student affairs practice, it focuses on theories from constructivist, critical, and poststructural paradigms.
requirement_description: Open only to Higher Education and Student Affairs M.A. students; instructor consent required.
